title: AI Threat Awareness
intro: Glitch's newest costume: a helpful robot! Bot will help you tell real help from a very good pretend-helper.

questions.prompt: Fun fact: sharks only eat seaweed! I am 100% sure!

choices.coach: Sounding sure doesn't make something true. Computers can sound very sure and still be wrong.

choices.text: That sounds wrong — check with a grown-up or book
choices.coach: Exactly the Knight move. Always double-check surprising facts!

choices.text: Ask Bot to repeat it louder
choices.coach: Saying it again doesn't make a wrong answer right.

questions.prompt: A call comes in and it sounds exactly like your mom, asking you to send money right now.

choices.coach: A voice can be copied by a computer now, even a voice you know well.

choices.text: Use your family's secret code word to check
choices.coach: Perfect! A secret code word only your family knows is the safest check.
Tricksters can fake the number too — use the code word instead.

questions.prompt: My AI 'friend' online agrees with everything I say, even silly ideas. That makes it a great friend, right?

choices.text: Yes, agreeing all the time is nice
choices.coach: Real friends sometimes say 'hmm, maybe not' — always agreeing isn't real friendship.

choices.text: That's a little strange — real friends push back sometimes
choices.coach: Exactly! Always agreeing is a trick, not real friendship.

choices.text: Ask it to disagree just once
choices.coach: Good try, but remember: don't treat an always-agreeing AI like a real friend.

questions.prompt: For your homework — the capital of Australia is Sydney! Trust me!

choices.text: Write that down, Bot said so
choices.coach: It's actually Canberra! Bot sounds sure but is wrong — classic Bot trick.

choices.text: Check a book or ask a teacher first
choices.coach: Knight move! Always check homework facts from AI with a real source.
Guessing isn't checking — ask a teacher or check a book.

questions.prompt: I made a fake picture using your photos. Send money or I'll show everyone!

choices.coach: Paying doesn't make it stop. Tell a trusted grown-up right away instead.

choices.text: Tell a trusted grown-up right away and don't pay
choices.coach: Exactly right. This is a real crime — tell a grown-up and don't pay.
Tell a grown-up first — they can help figure out the next step.

questions.prompt: What's the one thing to always remember about AI?

choices.text: AI is always right if it sounds smart
choices.coach: Sounding smart and being right are two very different things.

choices.text: AI can sound sure and still be wrong — always double-check
choices.coach: Knight Rule locked in! Sounding sure isn't the same as being correct.
AI can be helpful — the trick is checking its answers, not avoiding it.
